text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember when all the Mejiro
kids used
to play together? We'd have
races in the garden
and go to summer
festivals together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now that you mention it, we did
fireworks on the
estate grounds too,
didn't we? We had our little
sparklers in
hand and smiles on our faces.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, I remember that! We had the
adults set
off the big fireworks. It was a
great night!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Dober, you were scared of the loud
noises,
weren't you? I remember seeing
you cling to
Ryan. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I... I was just a bit startled! Only a little!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haha, they were pretty ear-popping. No
one
blames you for being scared!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That was when we were kids! I'm okay
with
fireworks now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Actually, now that you mention it, why
don't we
have another big fireworks
show at the Mejiro
estate?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Nice idea! Let's put on an even bigger,
more
impressive show this time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like the house will be getting
lively again.
Hehe, I can't wait.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Good... I can show you both how much
I've grown!
